#en: Let's hear it.
zh: 说来听听。

#en: Sure, fire away.
zh: 好，尽管问。

#en: Alright, let's chat.
zh: 好，我们聊聊。

#en: Sure thing, go ahead.
zh: 当然，请说。

#en: Of course, what's on your mind?
zh: 当然，你在想什么？

#en: I'll answer whatever I can.
zh: 我能答什么就答什么。

#en: Sure! Nothing's off-limits. Well, almost nothing.
zh: 当然！没什么不能问的。嗯，几乎没有。

#en: Anything you need to know, just ask.
zh: 你想知道什么，尽管问。

#en: Go ahead. Nothing's off the table.
zh: 说吧。没什么不能谈的。

#en: Absolutely. You can ask me anything.
zh: 当然。你什么都可以问我。

#en: And if there's anything you asked me before, feel free to ask again. Now that you know the truth, I'll try to not be so "evasive".
zh: 如果之前问过我什么，也尽管再问。既然你知道真相了，我会尽量不那么"闪烁其词"。

#en: Now that you know I'm Starborn, I'd assume you have some questions about that! Hah, well, I'll gladly share what I can.
zh: 既然你知道我是星裔了，我猜你对此有些疑问！哈，我很乐意分享我能说的。

#en: And it'll be nice to talk to someone who's in the same cosmic boat, so to speak... Ask whatever you want!
zh: 而且能跟一个可以说"同在这条宇宙船上"的人聊聊也挺好……你想问什么都行！

#en: Since you're a full-blown Starborn, there's no reason for me to hide anything from you. Not anymore...
zh: 既然你已是货真价实的星裔，我就没理由对你隐瞒什么了。不再有……

#en: What should I do next?
zh: 我接下来该做什么？

#en: Mind if we talk? I have a few questions.
zh: 介意聊聊吗？我有几个问题。

#en: I'd like to think I have many useful skills! But I suppose... Piloting, Missile Weapon Systems and Starship Engineering. That would be what I'm best at.
zh: 我想我有很多有用的技能！不过我想……驾驶、导弹武器系统和星舰工程。这是我最擅长的。

#en: What's your area of expertise?
zh: 你的专长是什么？

#en: You should return to Stardock.
zh: 你该回星坞了。

#en: Time to see what's out there.
zh: 该去看看外面有什么了。

#en: Sure, let's get to it.
zh: 好，我们开始吧。

#en: Got it. I'm on you.
zh: 明白。我跟着你。

#en: Alright, let's make some tracks!
zh: 好，我们出发！

#en: Okay, I'm right behind you.
zh: 好，我就在你后面。

#en: You got it. Lead the way!
zh: 没问题。带路吧！

#en: Alright, heading back. Might take the scenic route, though...
zh: 好，我回去了。不过可能会走条风景好的路……

#en: No sweat. I'll catch a ride back. Safe travels out there.
zh: 别担心。我搭个顺风船回去。外面一路平安。

#en: Alright, I'll head back. See you later!
zh: 好，我回去了。回头见！

#en: No problem. I'll hitch a ride back to Stardock.
zh: 没问题。我搭个顺风船回星坞。

#en: Got it. Don't worry, I'll find my way back.
zh: 明白。别担心，我能自己回去。

#en: Roger that! Plotting a course, powering Grav Drive...
zh: 收到！正在规划航线，重力引擎充能中……

#en: Understood, heading to Stardock. Later!
zh: 明白，前往星坞。回头见！

#en: I'll set a course right away! Shouldn't take me too long. Bye for now.
zh: 我这就设定航线！应该不会太久。先再见了。

#en: Alright, I'll fly back to Stardock. Should be a smooth enough trip.
zh: 好，我飞回星坞。应该会一路顺利。

#en: Okay, I'll take my ship and head back. Catch you later!
zh: 好，我开自己的飞船回去。回头见！

#en: Let's get moving.
zh: 我们走吧。

#en: Take your time. I'll be here when you're ready to move on.
zh: 慢慢来。等你准备好继续时我就在这儿。

#en: I'll just hang tight 'til you're back.
zh: 我就待着等你回来。

#en: Got it. I'll wait here. Promise I won't wander off.
zh: 明白。我在这儿等。保证不乱跑。

#en: Alright, I'll wait here. Just don't forget about me, okay?
zh: 好，我在这儿等。只是别把我忘了，行吗？

#en: You got it. I'll hold down the fort while you're off doing... whatever.
zh: 没问题。你去忙你的事时我在这儿守着。

#en: I'll be right here. Don't take too long, though!
zh: 我就在这儿。不过别太久！

#en: Wait here a moment.
zh: 在这儿等一下。

#en: You can return to your post now.
zh: 你现在可以回岗位了。

#en: How could I say no? You've got yourself a tagalong.
zh: 我怎么能拒绝？你多了个跟班。

#en: Sure thing! I was hoping you'd ask.
zh: 当然！我就盼着你开口。

#en: Lead on, fearless leader. I'm right behind you!
zh: 带路吧，无畏的领袖。我就在你后面！

#en: Sure! What's life without a little wandering about the universe...
zh: 当然！没有点漫游宇宙的经历，人生还有什么意思……

#en: Of course! I've got your back.
zh: 当然！我支持你。

#en: Sounds like an adventure waiting to happen. I'm in!
zh: 听着就像一场即将上演的冒险。算我一个！

#en: I'm in. But if there's a uniform, I draw the line at matching hats.
zh: 我加入。但要是得穿制服，配同款帽子就免了。

#en: Absolutely. I've been meaning to stretch my space legs.
zh: 当然。我一直想活动活动太空腿脚。

#en: Sure thing! Sounds like fun.
zh: 当然！听着挺有意思。

#en: Sure! Somebody's gotta keep you outta trouble
zh: 当然！总得有人看着你别惹麻烦

#en: I'd be delighted. I'll make my way to your ship.
zh: 我很乐意。我这就去你的飞船。

#en: Best offer I've had all day! Count me in.
zh: 这是我今天收到的最好的邀请！算我一个。

#en: Would you mind joining my crew?
zh: 你愿意加入我的船员队伍吗？

#en: I'd like you to follow me for a while.
zh: 我希望你跟我走一阵子。

#en: Hey, remember the location of that Watchtower warehouse? Whole bunch of Computer Cores and useful hardware there up for grabs! Just need the code to get in.
zh: 嘿，还记得那座瞭望塔仓库的位置吗？那里有一大堆计算机核心和有用的硬件可以拿！只需要进去的密码。

#en: Once we've spoken to him, we can finally get this Watchtower plan rolling.
zh: 等跟他谈过，我们终于可以让这个瞭望塔计划动起来了。

#en: Let's head back to Stardock! Gren will be in his workshop.
zh: 我们回星坞吧！格伦会在他的工坊里。

#en: Let's head down to Gren's workshop, we should be able to find him there.
zh: 我们去格伦的工坊，应该能在那里找到他。

#en: No sweat, we still have plenty of time. Well, maybe not plenty, but we do have some time! Just let me know when you're ready.
zh: 别担心，我们还有充足的时间。嗯，也许不算充足，但确实还有些时间！你准备好了就告诉我。

#en: Changed my mind, I'm not ready...
zh: 我改主意了，还没准备好……

#en: You'll want your best weapons and armored suits for this!
zh: 为此你最好带上最好的武器和护甲！

#en: We also shouldn't rule out the need for more "intimate" combat. So make sure your personal gear is up to snuff too!
zh: 我们也不能排除需要更"近距离"交战的可能。所以也要确保你的个人装备达标！

#en: Ideally, we want ships that are well-fitted for combat, and that includes Skydrops.
zh: 理想情况下，我们要适合战斗的飞船，其中也包括空投。

#en: Fleet size would be the obvious thing to focus on. The more ships, the better. But we don't want to bring junkers to the fight!
zh: 舰队规模显然是要重点关注的。飞船越多越好。但我们可不想带着破烂去打仗！

#en: What sort of things should I have prepared?
zh: 我该准备些什么？

#en: I do have one! But I'll need to clarify a few details first... We need to speak to Gren.
zh: 我确实有一个！但我得先弄清几个细节……我们得和格伦谈谈。

#en: Right, yes! Plan...
zh: 对，没错！计划……

#en: I'm ready. So what's the plan?
zh: 我准备好了。那么计划是什么？

#en: Once we start this, outside of a Unity jump, there's no going back...
zh: 一旦开始，除了归一跳跃，就没有回头路了……

#en: You sure your fleet's ready? And what about you? Fully stocked up on weapons and gear?
zh: 你确定舰队准备好了吗？那你呢？武器和装备都备齐了？

#en: I think it's time we dealt with Watchtower.
zh: 我觉得该处理瞭望塔了。

#en: Not going to leave that for the scavengers, eh?
zh: 不打算把这留给拾荒者，是吧？

#en: Something useful there?
zh: 那儿有什么有用的东西吗？

#en: No sense in letting it spoil.
zh: 让它坏掉可没道理。

#en: You dig in, I'll just watch.
zh: 你慢慢翻，我就看着。

#en: Nature provides.
zh: 大自然自有馈赠。

#en: Could be something valuable in there...
zh: 里面可能有值钱的东西……

#en: No point letting perfectly good resources go to waste.
zh: 让好好的资源浪费掉可没意义。

#en: Think something's here?
zh: 觉得这儿有东西？

#en: Take your time...
zh: 慢慢来……

#en: What are you looking for?
zh: 你在找什么？

#en: Guess I'll just stand here looking pretty...
zh: 那我想我就站在这儿当个花瓶吧……

#en: I'm all for exploring and scanning.
zh: 我完全赞成探索和扫描。

#en: If you ping something cool, let me know!
zh: 你要是扫到什么好东西，告诉我一声！

#en: Looking for something?
zh: 在找什么吗？

#en: Alright, I'll leave you to it.
zh: 好，我就不打扰你了。

#en: Understood. Returning to my post.
zh: 明白。我回岗位了。

#en: You've got it! Heading back.
zh: 没问题！我回去了。

#en: Okay, back to regular duties.
zh: 好，回去干常规的活儿。

#en: Alright, I'll return to my post.
zh: 好，我回岗位。

#en: Got it. Back to the grind...
zh: 明白。回去搬砖……

#en: Try not to cause too much trouble without me.
zh: 没我在的时候别惹太多麻烦。

#en: Sure, I'll hold down the fort.
zh: 好，我在这儿守着。

#en: Got it. I'll keep the engine warm or something.
zh: 明白。我把引擎热着什么的。

#en: No worries, I'll make myself useful behind the scenes.
zh: 别担心，我会在幕后找点有用的事做。

#en: Alright, guess I'm on standby.
zh: 好，那我想我待命吧。

#en: I've seen cargo freighters carry less. Let me help.
zh: 我见过货运飞船装的都没你多。让我搭把手。

#en: I get that you like souvenirs, but it's getting out of hand!
zh: 我明白你喜欢纪念品，但这也太夸张了！

#en: If you topple over, I'm leaving you here.
zh: 你要是被压趴下了，我可就把你留这儿了。

#en: You're starting to look like a walking junk heap. Hand some over!
zh: 你都快变成会走路的垃圾堆了。拿点过来！

#en: At this rate, we'll reach our destination in a week...
zh: 照这速度，我们得一个星期才能到地方……

#en: C'mon, let me lighten your load.
zh: 来吧，让我给你减减负。

#en: You sure you need all that...?
zh: 你确定需要带这些……？

#en: Hah! I'll have to remember that one.
zh: 哈！这一手我得记下来。

#en: Keep that kinda display up, and I might learn a thing or two.
zh: 你再这么耍下去，我也许还能学两手。

#en: Man, that move never gets old, does it?
zh: 老天，那招永远看不腻，是吧？

#en: Impressive! Makes my own abilities feel downright tame in comparison.
zh: 厉害！相比之下我自己的能力显得平平无奇。

#en: You handle that better than most folks handle a gun!
zh: 你玩那个比大多数人用枪还溜！

#en: Hah! Got 'em.
zh: 哈！解决了。

#en: Think you could teach me how to do that?
zh: 你觉得能教教我怎么做到吗？

#en: You handle that power well!
zh: 你把那股力量掌握得很好！

#en: How much did you have to practice to pull that off?
zh: 你得练多久才能使出那一招？

#en: Huh! That's one neat trick.
zh: 嗯！那招挺妙。

#en: Let's not stay here longer than we have to.
zh: 我们别在这儿多耽搁。

#en: Just so you know, hazard suits only do so much...
zh: 跟你说一声，防护服能顶的也有限……

#en: Are we going to bail? This place, it's not safe.
zh: 我们要撤吗？这地方不安全。

#en: My suit's complaining. Never a good sign!
zh: 我的防护服在报警了。这从来不是好兆头！

#en: Air's thick with... ugh, who-knows-what...
zh: 空气里充满了……呃，谁知道是什么……

#en: I'm picking up some nasty readings here...
zh: 我这儿读到一些不妙的读数……

#en: Uh, yeah... I think this place wants to kill us.
zh: 呃，是啊……我觉得这地方想弄死我们。

#en: I'll try not to make this a habit.
zh: 我会尽量不让这成为习惯。

#en: Ah, my hero! Thanks.
zh: 啊，我的英雄！谢谢。

#en: Ahh... Thanks for not letting me bleed out!
zh: 啊……谢谢你没让我流血而死！

#en: Phew, I appreciate the patch-up.
zh: 呼，谢谢你的紧急处理。

#en: Ahh, thanks! Feeling spry again!
zh: 啊，谢谢！又觉得精神了！

#en: Need some gear?
zh: 需要些装备吗？

#en: I can haul a few things.
zh: 我能扛几件东西。

#en: My pockets are your pockets.
zh: 我的口袋就是你的口袋。

#en: I can hold a few things.
zh: 我能拿几件东西。

#en: I'm all ears, whatcha got for me?
zh: 我洗耳恭听，有什么要给我的？

#en: I can lighten your load
zh: 我能给你减负

#en: Picking up, or dropping off?
zh: 是要取，还是要存？

#en: I've got room in my pack.
zh: 我的背包还有空间。

#en: If you need something from me, just grab it.
zh: 如果你需要我身上的东西，直接拿。

#en: Need me to carry something?
zh: 需要我拿什么东西吗？

#en: Bleak and barren...
zh: 荒凉贫瘠……

#en: Just because it seems we're alone here, don't assume that's the case.
zh: 别因为这里看着只有我们，就以为真是这样。

#en: No signs of life... yet.
zh: 还没有生命迹象……目前。

#en: Doesn't look like much here, but who knows?
zh: 这儿看起来没什么，但谁知道呢？

#en: Don't see any wildlife, probably not a hotspot for visitors.
zh: 没看到什么野生动物，大概不是什么访客常来的地方。

#en: Could be some resources hidden under all this planet's nothingness.
zh: 这颗行星一片荒芜之下，也许藏着些资源。

#en: Huh. Kinda eerie here...
zh: 嗯。这儿有点瘆人……

#en: I won't be shocked to encounter other explorers here...
zh: 在这儿碰到其他探险者我也不会惊讶……

#en: There's so much life in the universe! More than you'd expect.
zh: 宇宙里的生命真多！比你想象的多。

#en: Can't beat a planet teeming with life!
zh: 生机勃勃的行星，那才是最好的！

#en: Wonder what we'll discover here if we dig a little deeper.
zh: 不知道再挖深一点会发现什么。

#en: Whole area's practically begging for explorers!
zh: 这整片区域简直在召唤探险者！

#en: I'm betting we'll run into some wildlife here.
zh: 我打赌我们会在这儿遇到些野生动物。

#en: Lush, somewhat green, and probably crawling with critters!
zh: 郁郁葱葱、带着几分绿意，多半还有不少小生物！

#en: Sometimes I worry we'll pass through The Unity, only to find no station here.
zh: 有时我担心穿过归一后，会发现这里根本没有空间站。

#en: Hm. Stardock. Nice to have some consistency in the universe...
zh: 嗯。星坞。能在这宇宙里有点不变的东西真好……

#en: Ah, Stardock--... Uh, wait, what letter are we on now?
zh: 啊，星坞——……呃，等等，我们现在到哪个字母了？

#en: Wanna grab a drink while we're here?
zh: 要在这儿喝一杯吗？

#en: *crunch* I wonder if B.A.B.S. will carry my gear for me...
zh: *咔嚓*不知道B.A.B.S.愿不愿意帮我扛装备……

#en: Glad to see the station's still running smoothly.
zh: 很高兴看到空间站还在顺畅运转。

#en: Nice to see the place still humming along.
zh: 看到这地方还在忙碌运转真好。

#en: Station looks good. Harper's been busy.
zh: 空间站看起来不错。哈珀一直很忙。

#en: Home sweet home, just as we left it. More or less.
zh: 甜蜜的家，跟我们离开时一样。差不多吧。

#en: *crunch* Same again! Always is...
zh: *咔嚓*还是老样子！总是这样……

#en: In my home universe, Londinion was a sight to behold. Not like here...
zh: 在我原本的宇宙里，隆蒂涅恩城可是蔚为壮观。跟这里不一样……

#en: *sigh* You know, every universe I jump to, this place is always the same...
zh: *叹气*你知道，我跳到的每一个宇宙，这地方都一模一样……

#en: Careful here. There's a reason this place was abandoned...
zh: 这里小心点。这地方被废弃是有原因的……

#en: *crunch* One of these jumps, maybe we should try to find out more on the whole serpent god thing.
zh: *咔嚓*哪次跳跃，我们也许该去多了解了解那个蛇神的事。

#en: Doesn't matter how many times we might come here, still weird.
zh: 不管来多少次，还是觉得怪。

#en: Before joining up with you, never visited Dazra before.
zh: 在跟你会合之前，我从没来过达兹拉。

#en: This should be interesting...
zh: 这应该会很有意思……

#en: Dazra. Hm. Weird place...
zh: 达兹拉。嗯。怪地方……

#en: Didn't expect to be landing here today...
zh: 没想到今天会在这儿着陆……

#en: If anyone asks, we're just passing through. Right?
zh: 要是有人问起，我们就说是路过。对吧？

#en: Got a feeling they don't get many tourists here...
zh: 感觉这里没什么游客……

#en: House Va'ruun's home turf, huh?
zh: 瓦鲁家族的地盘，是吧？

#en: Do Constellation know you're Starborn? Hm. What an awkward conversation...
zh: 星宿座知道你是星裔吗？嗯。那场面得多尴尬……

#en: You off to visit Constellation? Hah, maybe I should join them some time...
zh: 你要去拜访星宿座？哈，也许哪天我也该加入他们……

#en: New Atlantis, it's not what it seems, you know? At least, not in most universes.
zh: 新亚特兰蒂斯城，它并不像表面看起来那样，你知道吗？至少大多数宇宙里不是。

#en: ...Always surprises me how Earth-like this planet is...
zh: ……这颗行星像地球到这种程度，总让我吃惊……

#en: There are worse places to land than New Atlantis.
zh: 比新亚特兰蒂斯城更差的着陆点有的是。

#en: Ugh... The people here creep me out.
zh: 呃……这儿的人让我发毛。

#en: You ever wonder what Jemison was like before humans arrived?
zh: 你有没有想过，人类到来之前的杰米森是什么样？

#en: Skyline's pretty spectacular here, if a bit cluttered.
zh: 这里的天际线相当壮观，虽说有点杂乱。

#en: *crunch* New Atlantis! Shiny, impressive... Shame that most of it's just a charade.
zh: *咔嚓*新亚特兰蒂斯城！光鲜、气派……可惜大部分都只是做戏。

#en: Was hoping we could avoid Neon this jump...
zh: 我还指望这一跳能避开霓虹城……

#en: *crunch* You know what they do with the fish here, right...?
zh: *咔嚓*你知道他们拿这里的鱼做什么吧……？

#en: Worked for Ryujin once, mostly out of curiosity. Didn't care for it.
zh: 我曾为龙神集团干过，多半是出于好奇。不太喜欢。

#en: Few places I've been that are more crime-ridden than Neon...
zh: 我去过的地方里，比霓虹城犯罪更猖獗的没几个……

#en: Watch your pockets here. Things like to go missing...
zh: 在这儿看好你的口袋。东西说没就没……

#en: Let's handle business and get off this rig as soon as we can.
zh: 我们办完事就尽快离开这鬼地方。

#en: This place always makes my head spin.
zh: 这地方总让我头晕。

#en: Think we'll see any sea monsters?
zh: 你觉得我们会看到海怪吗？

#en: Never liked Neon, too much shady stuff. Reminds me of Watchtower.
zh: 一直不喜欢霓虹城，见不得人的事太多。让我想起瞭望塔。

#en: Had a shootout here once. Didn't end well. So much for playing Sheriff...
zh: 我曾在这儿有过一场枪战。结局不太好。当治安官这事就算了……

#en: You ever feel tempted to draw pistols here and just go crazy? No? Just-- just me...? Alright.
zh: 你有没有在这儿想掏枪大干一场的冲动？没有？只是——只是我……？好吧。

#en: So, back to Akila. Suppose there are worse places to be.
zh: 那么，又回到阿基拉城。想来还有比这儿更糟的地方。

#en: Wonder if the local watering hole has anything decent on tap.
zh: 不知道本地酒馆有没有像样的酒。

#en: *crunch* Heh, "Rangers". Kinda cute, really! All dressed up and playing cowboy.
zh: *咔嚓*嘿，"游骑兵"。还挺可爱！一身行头扮牛仔。

#en: Might be tough, but try to keep a low profile here. Trust me.
zh: 可能有点难，但在这儿尽量低调。相信我。

#en: I prefer a bit more lawlessness, and Akila delivers!
zh: 我更喜欢多一点无法无天，阿基拉城正合我意！

#en: Akila's a testament to human stubbornness, I'll give 'em that.
zh: 阿基拉城是人类执拗的证明，这点我得承认。

#en: Freestar territory's not exactly my go-to...
zh: 星联的地盘可不是我的首选……

#en: You think we'll ever see this place... I dunno, less dusty?
zh: 你觉得我们能看到这地方……怎么说呢，少点尘土吗？

#en: Before meeting you, I always seemed to find trouble on Mars.
zh: 在遇见你之前，我老是在火星上惹上麻烦。

#en: You know, one jump, I saw this place completely terraformed! It was beautiful.
zh: 你知道，有一次跳跃，我看到这地方被完全地球化了！很美。

#en: *sigh* Cydonia... Not my cup of tea.
zh: *叹气*赛多尼亚……不合我的口味。

#en: Don't breathe too deep while we're here...
zh: 在这儿别深呼吸……

#en: *crunch* You ever hear that old myth, about the rock with a face?
zh: *咔嚓*你听说过那个老传说吗，关于长着人脸的那块岩石？

#en: I never liked the whole dusty mining vibe...
zh: 我一直不喜欢那种尘土飞扬的采矿氛围……

#en: Not my first time here...
zh: 这不是我第一次来……

#en: Mars, huh? Red dust and old stories.
zh: 火星，是吧？红色的尘土和古老的故事。

#en: We're not exactly invited, so watch for surprises.
zh: 我们可没被邀请，所以当心点。

#en: Let's scope it out real quick...
zh: 我们快速查看一下……

#en: Keep that trigger finger ready, just in case!
zh: 手指放在扳机上，以防万一！

#en: We can poke around, just be careful.
zh: 我们可以四处看看，只是小心点。

#en: Hope they don't mind unexpected guests...
zh: 希望他们不介意不速之客……

#en: I'll watch your back, but still keep your eyes peeled.
zh: 我会替你看着后面，但你自己也得留神。

#en: Let's be polite visitors. No stealing or smashing. Unless... we have to.
zh: 我们做个礼貌的访客。不偷不砸。除非……不得不。

#en: I get the feeling that we're trespassing...
zh: 我有种我们正在擅闯的感觉……

#en: This is someone else's ride, so let's step carefully, huh?
zh: 这是别人的船，所以我们走稳点，行吗？

#en: Thought you might want this...
zh: 想你可能想要这个……

#en: Hey, snagged something cool for ya.
zh: 嘿，给你顺了件好东西。

#en: If we destroy the Array, we might be able to recover some data from the wreckage! But first, we gotta deal with our "friends" here.
zh: 如果我们摧毁阵列，也许能从残骸中找回些数据！但首先，我们得应付这里的"朋友"。

#en: When Watchtower show, they'd easily be able to capture us! One shot from their Disruptor and we'd be sitting ducks! C'mon, let's head to Stardock instead.
zh: 瞭望塔一出现，就能轻易抓住我们！他们的干扰器一枪就能让我们坐以待毙！来吧，我们还是去星坞吧。

#en: The Altair system... You're not thinking about taking out the Listening Post, are you? We've only got one ship, you know!
zh: 牵牛星星系……你不会是想去端掉那个监听哨吧？我们只有一艘飞船，你知道的！

#en: Go snatch up the important stuff. Slate, Cores, and a few components... Then back to Stardock.
zh: 去把重要的东西拿走。数据板、核心，还有几个部件……然后回星坞。

#en: Time to mop up the scraps. Intel Slate, Cores, and so on, then we head home to Stardock.
zh: 该收拾残局了。情报数据板、核心之类的，然后我们回星坞。

#en: All that's left is to clean up. Grab the Slate, Cores and components! Then jump on back to Stardock.
zh: 剩下就是打扫战场。拿走数据板、核心和部件！然后跃迁回星坞。

#en: We just need to find the Intel Slate for Harper, and components for Gren. Oh, and the Computers Cores too! Then back to Stardock we go.
zh: 我们只要找到给哈珀的情报数据板，还有给格伦的部件。哦，还有计算机核心！然后我们就回星坞。

#en: Let's grab the Intel Slate, Cores and components from the wrecks, then head back to Stardock.
zh: 我们从残骸里拿走情报数据板、核心和部件，然后回星坞。

#en: Easy win. Just goes to show, a fleet's the best insurance policy.
zh: 轻松取胜。这就说明，舰队是最好的保险。

#en: Oh yeah! That's what I'm talking about. Eat fleet, Watchtower...
zh: 哦耶！这才像话。尝尝舰队的厉害吧，瞭望塔……

#en: Hah! Good to see having a fleet still works for now.
zh: 哈！很高兴有舰队这招眼下还有效。

#en: Done and dusted! A fleet's clearly still the way to go!
zh: 干净利落！有舰队果然还是正道！

#en: Yup, the fleet strategy is a winner in this Universe too! At least for now...
zh: 对，舰队策略在这个宇宙里同样管用！至少目前如此……

#en: Here we go! Us vs. Watchtower... The ultimate grudge match!
zh: 来吧！我们对瞭望塔……终极宿怨之战！

#en: Let's demonstrate the meaning of "strength in numbers"!
zh: 让我们来演示一下什么叫"人多力量大"！

#en: Let's show this version of Watchtower what a fleet can do!
zh: 让这个宇宙的瞭望塔见识见识舰队的本事！

#en: This should be a walk in the park, let's put 'em down!
zh: 这应该是小菜一碟，把他们干掉！

#en: Hey, it's our Watchtower buddies! Let's give 'em a warm welcome!
zh: 嘿，是我们瞭望塔的老朋友！让我们好好"欢迎"他们！

#en: Alright, planet operation complete. On to the Array!
zh: 好，行星行动完成。去阵列那边！

#en: All clear down here. Now let's get that Array in orbit!
zh: 下面都清干净了。现在去解决轨道上的阵列！

#en: Okay, Array time! Doubt it'll be too tough.
zh: 好，该对付阵列了！估计不会太难。

#en: Nice, now back to the black to deal with the Array.
zh: 不错，现在回到太空去处理阵列。

#en: Ground complex dealt with, the sky calls!
zh: 地面设施已解决，天空在召唤！

#en: Standard procedure. We secure the Post on the surface, then tackle the Array above. Let's move, move! *chuckle*
zh: 标准流程。我们先拿下地表的监听哨，再对付上面的阵列。走，快走！*轻笑*

#en: Same routine! Hit the ground first for the Listening Post, then head spaceward for the Array.
zh: 老规矩！先落地解决监听哨，再上太空对付阵列。

#en: Scan for the Listening Post, then on to the Array!
zh: 扫描找到监听哨，然后去阵列！

#en: Time to get scanning for the Post! Then we can take care of the Array.
zh: 该扫描寻找监听哨了！然后就能处理阵列。

#en: You know the drill! Find the Listening Post on the ground, then back into space for the Array!
zh: 你知道套路！找到地表的监听哨，然后回到太空对付阵列！

#en: Here we are. Now, we can't go straight to the Array, as it'll likely be in a different spot. So, we'll need to hit the ground facility first. Okay, get scanning!
zh: 我们到了。现在，我们不能直接去阵列，因为它多半在另一个位置。所以我们得先去地面设施。好，开始扫描！

#en: *laugh* Glad to see the "fleet strategy" works as anticipated. We should search the Array's wreckage. See if we can recover that intel for Harper.
zh: *笑*很高兴看到"舰队策略"如预期奏效。我们该搜查阵列的残骸。看看能不能为哈珀找回那些情报。

#en: Whoo!! That's how it's done!
zh: 哇哦！！就该这么干！

#en: Altair system, huh? You know... we could scan for the Altair III Listening Post, then take care of the Array before Harper asks us to? If you wanted...
zh: 牵牛星星系，是吧？你知道……我们可以先扫描找到牵牛星III的监听哨，然后在哈珀开口之前就把阵列解决掉？如果你愿意的话……

#en: Time to go! I'll travel with you. Next stop: Watchtower Listening Post.
zh: 该出发了！我跟你一起走。下一站：瞭望塔监听哨。

#en: That's it, then. I'll be tagging along on your ship. Listening Post, here we come!
zh: 那就这样。我跟着上你的飞船。监听哨，我们来了！

#en: Okay, that was all we had to do! I'll join you aboard your ship. Let's go get that Listening Post!
zh: 好，我们要做的都做完了！我上你的飞船跟你一起。去拿下那个监听哨！

#en: Done and done! I'll go jump on my ship, then off we go!
zh: 搞定！我上我的飞船，然后出发！

#en: Looks like we're set. I'll board my ship, see you in space!
zh: 看来我们准备好了。我登船了，太空见！

#en: That's everything! I'll go board my ship, and we can head off. To the Listening Post!
zh: 都齐了！我去登船，我们就能出发了。目标监听哨！
